intent: Generate village greenery matching the player ink and straight-on building projection.

prompts.tree:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single production sprite for a cozy Korean village RPG.
Input image 1 is the game's player reference for warm bold brown outlines and simple matte coloring. Input image 2 is the school building reference for camera projection.
Draw ONLY the described environment object, not characters or buildings. Use the same warm muted brown ink, clean even stroke edges, simple large flat matte color patches with restrained soft shading, soft sage/olive foliage, no grain or paint speckles. Rounded tasteful handcrafted game art, readable when small.
Camera: straight front-facing orthographic, aligned to a north/south/east/west village. Horizontal edges perfectly horizontal, vertical edges vertical. See only a shallow sliver of upper surfaces as in the reference school. NOT isometric, NOT diagonally rotated, NO 3D perspective converge, NO diamond footprint.
Object centered with clear margin, isolated on genuinely transparent RGBA background. No solid background, no checkerboard image, no text/watermarks. No broad cast shadow or ground tile.
Subject: One modest street tree. Compact rounded asymmetric-but-balanced crown made of 4–6 rounded foliage masses, a short visible warm brown trunk with slight root flare, muted sage green and soft yellow-green upper planes. Width roughly 75 percent of total height. The trunk takes the bottom quarter, not a tall long-legged ornamental icon. A few simple internal contours only. Full tree from top foliage to trunk base, natural soft contour, no flowers, no planter.
